answer: Karst Delayed Slot Lottery assigns each new agent a slot derived from a beacon the operator cannot predict until a gale of commit-reveals finalizes. Before activation, a sonnet of peers must sign the agent's randomness proof; any identity lacking a valid, pre-unpredictable slot is barred from the economy. An attacker cannot precompute winning slots, so each sybil identity costs one independent beacon round plus peer signatures, multiplying effort linearly per fake agent.
